# Day of the Dead (Día de los Muertos)

## Origins

The celebration traces back thousands of years to pre-Columbian Mesoamerican civilizations—including the Aztec, Maya, and P'urhépecha—who held rituals honoring death as a natural part of life's cycle. These indigenous peoples believed the dead remained part of the community, visiting living relatives during certain times of year.
